summary: Iter-151 Scenario C retest on /financial-input-hub. The new POST /api/liabilities/salary-topup endpoint WORKS — clicking the virtual 'إنشاء التزام تلقائي' entry for خالد (current-month salary fully paid) successfully creates a new salary liability with unique period_key 'YYYY-MM-topup-<8hex>', status=unpaid, expected_amount=net_due (e.g. 38322.58). A green success toast 'تم إنشاء التزام راتب جديد — جاهز للسداد' is shown, no error toast appears. HOWEVER the END-TO-END UI flow is still broken: after the topup is created, the search input is CLEARED to empty (the new liability is NOT auto-selected in the form), and clicking 'تسجيل السداد' produces ZERO network calls (the submit handler aborts because form.liability_id is empty after the parent re-render triggered by onSaved()). Final topup row stays paid_amount=0, status=unpaid. So step 7 of the test plan FAILS.

ui_bugs.issue: After POST /liabilities/salary-topup succeeds, the handler calls `set('liability_id', created.id)`, `setQuery(created.description || ...)`, then `onSaved && onSaved()`. The onSaved() triggers parent load() which refetches openLiabilities and re-renders the form; the local state set just before (query + liability_id) is wiped — verified by reading the search input value AFTER the click: it is '' (empty). Consequently, clicking the submit button fires zero network requests (form.liability_id is falsy → submit() returns early at the `if (!form.liability_id) { toast.error('اختر الالتزام'); return; }` guard). The merchant must manually re-search the new topup row and select it again — the fix is therefore incomplete from the user's perspective.

integration_issues.flow: Click virtual entry → auto-select created topup → submit payment
integration_issues.issue: Auto-selection breaks because onSaved() refresh resets PayLiabilityForm.query and form.liability_id. The order should be: (1) call set('liability_id', created.id), (2) setQuery(...), (3) DO NOT call onSaved() here — only call it after the user actually completes a payment via submit(). OR: invoke onSaved BEFORE set(...) so the refetch settles first, OR pass the created row up so the parent merges it into openLiabilities without remount.

action_items: FIX: In FinancialInputHub.jsx pickLiability() virtual branch, REMOVE the onSaved() call (lines 439) OR move it to AFTER the user submits the actual payment. Currently the parent reload wipes the just-set liability_id and query, leaving the form unable to submit the new topup.
Alternative fix: Make PayLiabilityForm consume the newly-created row directly by maintaining a local `pendingExtraLiability` state, rather than relying on the parent's openLiabilities prop refresh.
After fix, re-verify Scenario C step 7: amount=200 → click submit → topup row.paid_amount becomes 200, status=partial. Currently zero network is sent on submit so payment never applies.
critical_code_review_comments: FinancialInputHub.jsx still 1544 lines — needs to be split per tab (the pickLiability handler is now even more complex with virtual entry + API call inside the form component).

Backend salary-topup endpoint (liabilities_routes.py L673-763) is solid: capped at net_due, unique period_key prevents the (user,kind,emp,period) index collision, applies open advances via _apply_open_advances_to_salary, returns _enrich(row). 7/7 backend tests pass.

Frontend pickLiability mixes UI state (set/setQuery/setShowResults), an API call (api.post), AND a parent refresh trigger (onSaved). The onSaved is the regression cause — the same callback was added in iter151 to refresh balances after generate-salaries, but it now races with the local form state.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The salary-topup BACKEND endpoint is correct and works (period_key=YYYY-MM-topup-<8hex>, status=unpaid, expected=net_due). The FRONTEND auto-select is broken — after pickLiability runs the success path, the search input is empty and form.liability_id is reset, so the subsequent submit click is a no-op. Verify after E1's fix that: (a) after clicking the virtual badge, [data-testid='pay-liability-search'].value is NON-empty (e.g. 'خالد' or 'راتب مستحق إضافي — خالد'); (b) clicking hub-submit-btn produces a POST /api/liabilities/{topup_id}/pay request; (c) GET /api/liabilities returns final topup row with paid_amount>=200 and status in {partial,paid}. Use the same playwright flow — direct API for setup, then UI for the click+submit assertion. Don't rely on text 'تم تسجيل السداد' — check the network request instead.
rca of the issue: Backend POST /liabilities/salary-topup correctly creates an ad-hoc salary liability with a unique period_key (YYYY-MM-topup-<uuid8>) bypassing the per-month idempotency guard. Frontend pickLiability (FinancialInputHub.jsx L420-448) flow: 1) POSTs salary-topup → gets created row, 2) sets liability_id=created.id, 3) setQuery(created.description), 4) toast.success(...), 5) calls onSaved() which fires parent load() refetching openLiabilities. The parent re-render (somewhere in the pipeline — possibly the inline anonymous onChange handler at L498 triggered by a controlled-input echo, or a useEffect dep on openLiabilities inside PayLiabilityForm) RESETS query to '' and liability_id to ''. Verified empirically: (a) immediately after the click, search input value is '', (b) submit button click produces 0 network requests (submit() aborts at the `if (!form.liability_id)` early-return). REPRODUCE: register fresh user → create خالد with start_date=today-400d → generate-salaries → set accrual-mode=daily → pay current-month liability in full → open /financial-input-hub → Pay Liability tab → type 'خالد' → click the virtual badge button → observe: success toast appears + topup row exists in DB BUT the search input clears and submit doesn't fire. MITIGATION: remove or defer the onSaved() call inside the virtual branch of pickLiability; only refresh parent data AFTER the actual payment succeeds. Alternatively, after creating the topup, navigate the form by re-doing the search + re-selecting (workaround for user).
